shortDescription: Stacked z-levels (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP with live see-below. Pass 40 hotfixes (built green): (1) cross-level bulk haul no longer loops walking between heavy chunks; (2) cross-level RMB no longer red-errors via foreign GetOptions postfixes; (3) equal storage-priority on another level no longer invokes a cross-level haul (only STRICTLY-better tiers cross; explicit Haul Urgently still does).
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI 5000, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul tests) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED pass 40): the column is ONE BIG MAP for storage priority, but a cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level.** Equal (or lower) priority on another level NEVER invokes a cross-level haul - a stack is not ferried between two same-priority stockpiles on different levels (user directive 2026-07-26). Enforced centrally in `CrossLevelHaul.TargetLevelFor` (discards a non-beatsLocal storage verdict). Only explicit player intent (Allow Tool Haul Urgently -> ignorePins) still crosses on equal tier. Monotone (bounded by Critical) so no oscillation.
- **COMBAT doctrine: cross-map verb casts are impossible (engine map guard), so we spawn projectiles on the TARGET map and run our own warmup/burst/cooldown driver.** Turret support CAPABILITY-based (any Building_Turret whose AttackVerb is a Verb_LaunchProjectile).
- **COMBAT VISUALS doctrine (pass 38): the REAL projectile reads the cross-gap shot at 1:1, no fake tracer.**
- **FOG-OF-WAR doctrine (pass 39): the column is ONE BIG MAP for VISION too (optional CAI 5000).**
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (relearned pass 35):** foreign types (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/CE/CombatAI) must NEVER appear in a method SIGNATURE or field. CAI is REFLECTION-ONLY.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (pass 40):** any time we RE-ENTER a vanilla method we also patch (FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions), assume a FOREIGN prefix may SKIP the original and leave null out-params/returns. Never hand those nulls back to the outer caller or foreign POSTFIXES - coalesce at the boundary.

# PASS 40 — HOTFIX WAVE (END-USER REPORTS + STORAGE DOCTRINE REFINE) (BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending verify)

**BUG 1 — cross-level hauling loop: "pawns walk between chunks on a lower level but never pick them up; chunk stockpile on ground has free space."**
ROOT CAUSE: with Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream present, cross-level hauls route through `CrossLevelHaulJob.BuildBulk`, loading into INVENTORY (MASS-gated via `MassUtility.CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered`). A heavy stack (stone chunks, slag, corpses) exceeds free space -> inventory pickup returns 0 -> `JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels` walked the ENTIRE queue lifting nothing, ended empty, giver re-issued forever. All bulk givers funnel through one `Build`.
FIX: (a) `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` takes the bulk path ONLY when `CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered(pawn, seed) > 0`; else `BuildSingle` (carry-in-hands, always lifts one stack). (b) driver tracks `lastPickupOk` and stops gathering the instant a visit lifts nothing.

**BUG 2 — persistent red "Error trying to make float menu" on cross-level RMB (Melee Animation NRE).**
ROOT CAUSE: our GetOptions cross-level prefix RE-ENTERS `FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions` in `BuildOptions`. A foreign prefix (a bed-ownership mod in the report) SKIPS the vanilla original during that re-entrant call, leaving the returned list + out-context NULL. We passed the null back as `__result`; on the OUTER call Melee Animation's GetOptions POSTFIX does `__result.AddRange(...)` and NREs. Vanilla never returns null, so no third-party postfix guards it.
FIX: coalesce the re-entrant result to a non-null list and ensure a non-null `FloatMenuContext`, both inside `BuildOptions` and at the prefix's return-false boundary.

**REFINE 3 — STORAGE PRIORITY: equal-tier on another level must not invoke a haul (user directive 2026-07-26).**
Previously the low-priority givers (`WorkGiver_ABHaulAcrossLevels`/`Bulk`) took equal-tier "lateral" cross-level storage moves (better than the item's CURRENT cell but not better than the best LOCAL store). That ferried unstored stacks between two same-priority stockpiles on different levels. NOW `CrossLevelHaul.TargetLevelFor` discards any storage verdict that is not `beatsLocal` (destPrio STRICTLY > bestLocal) unless `ignorePins` (Allow Tool Haul Urgently). So autonomous cross-level storage moves happen only for a STRICTLY higher tier; equal/lower tiers stay with vanilla's local haul. The storage branch then falls through to the DEMAND path (construction/bill needs), which is unaffected. RMB "haul across" option likewise no longer appears for equal-tier (uses the same verdict).

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56): FOG OF WAR + CROSS-LEVEL VISION (IN PROGRESS, phases 1-3 built green, pending in-game verify)
Detection/reflection bridge + see-below honors CAI fog (option B, all configs) + cross-level FoW vision reveal pass. Architecture constraint (CAI advances fog only for the current map) still needs in-game observation before deciding Phase 4.

# PASS 38 — CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT VISUALS: REAL 1:1 PROJECTILE (built green) · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL (see refine 3 above) · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET FIRE · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 HARDENING · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json
Ships `About/known-issues.json` so MDT explains our ABGuard subsystem shutdowns in-game. Inert without MDT.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21). CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (pass 38). **Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (pass 40 - now discarded, not just deprioritized).**

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB · PASS 33 see-below input parity · PASS 36 one-big-map work priority · PASS 36b cross-gap aim pose + selection-gated combat overlays.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry · cross-level storage-priority parity (p37; **STRICTLY-better-only p40**, bulk heavy-chunk loop fixed p40) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · elevation lock (VERIFIED) · drag-box select (VERIFIED) · targeter widening (VERIFIED) · hover readout (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33) · one-big-map work priority (p36, VERIFIED) · cross-gap aim pose (p36b, VERIFIED) · modded turret cross-level fire (p36c) · cross-gap combat visuals (p38) · CAI 5000 phases 1-3 (p39, pending) · **cross-level RMB re-entrancy null-coalesce (p40)** · MDT known-issues.json · P0-P3 parity. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators, non-projectile turrets, feeding CAI threat-AI across the gap.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level haul; heavy-stack inventory-mass fallback p40)** · Allow Tool (Haul Urgently still crosses equal-tier) · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · **Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus / other GetOptions-patching mods (p40 re-entrancy null-coalesce)** · turrets: any Building_Turret with a projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP) — end-user hotfixes + storage doctrine:**
- REFINE 3 (storage priority): two chunk stockpiles at the SAME priority (one on ground, one on basement), scatter unstored chunks on the basement -> pawns must haul them to the BASEMENT (local) stockpile, NOT ferry any up the stairs. Then raise the GROUND stockpile to Preferred/Important -> chunks must now cross up (strictly-better). Lower it back to equal -> crossing stops. Confirm an Allow Tool "Haul Urgently" designation STILL crosses on equal tier.
- BUG 1 (companion Mehni.PickUpAndHaul): heavy chunks on basement, chunk stockpile on ground set STRICTLY HIGHER (so a cross-haul is actually wanted) -> a PUAH hauler must CARRY chunks up one at a time (single carry), never walk between them lifting nothing. Light items still bulk-scoop in one trip.
- BUG 2 (companion co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation): cross-level RMB (attack/haul/build/stairs/bed) must NOT throw "Error trying to make float menu"; Melee drafted options still appear on same-map clicks (no regression; the null path can't be forced locally without a GetOptions-skipping mod).
**PASS 39 — CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56): fog self-test + see-below honors fog + cross-level vision. **38 · 37 · 36c · 35** queues; compat/perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending verify): three fixes. (1) Cross-level BULK-haul loop fixed - `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` only bulk-loads a seed that fits inventory mass, else carries one in hands; bulk driver stops gathering once a visit lifts nothing. (2) Cross-level RMB red-error fixed - re-entrant `BuildOptions` null-coalesces the result/context a foreign GetOptions prefix leaves null (Melee Animation postfix no longer NREs). (3) Storage-priority doctrine refined per user directive - `TargetLevelFor` now discards any non-STRICTLY-better storage verdict (unless Allow Tool urgent), so equal-priority stockpiles on different levels never invoke a cross-level haul. Testing ISOLATED + dev column; bug 1 with Mehni.PickUpAndHaul, bug 2 with co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation.
